title: Agent Infra 的核心约束：隔离、安全与规模化
english: Recent industry updates center on moving AI agents into controlled production environments. A CNCF post identifies isolation, security, and scale as prerequisites for implementing agents with policy enforcement. In parallel, Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra to test user workflows and strengthen security, while CodeRabbit uses GPT-6.1 Sol to investigate security risks across complex codebases and support review of findings and proposed fixes. Together, these examples shift the discussion from model capability alone toward operational controls, workflow testing, security investigation, and scalable deployment for agent systems.
chinese: 本轮信息的共同主题是：AI Agent 的生产落地依赖基础设施控制能力。CNCF 将隔离、安全和规模化列为受控环境中实施 Agent 的前提，并强调策略执行。与此同时，Greptile 将 GPT-6 Astra 用于测试用户工作流和加强安全；CodeRabbit 使用 GPT-6.1 Sol 在复杂代码库中调查安全风险，并协助开发者审查发现项与拟议修复方案。重点已不只是模型能力，而是如何将 Agent 置于可控制、可执行策略且可规模化运行的工作流中。
why_it_matters: 对云原生和 AIOps 团队而言，Agent Infra 需要把隔离边界、策略执行、安全调查和工作流测试作为运行设计的一部分。对资深运维开发而言，这意味着能力重心会延伸到受控执行环境、复杂代码库的安全协作，以及支撑 Agent 规模化运行的工程实践。
interview_expression: I view agent infrastructure as an operational control problem, not only a model capability problem. In production, I would focus on isolation, policy enforcement, security investigation, and scalable workflow testing.

vocabulary.meaning: 隔离；将 Agent 置于受控环境中的边界控制。
vocabulary.example: Isolation is identified as a prerequisite for implementing agents in a controlled environment.

vocabulary.meaning: 策略执行；确保系统按既定规则运行。
vocabulary.example: Policy enforcement helps ensure that agents do what they are supposed to do.

vocabulary.meaning: 拟议修复方案；针对已发现问题提出的修复建议。
vocabulary.example: The security agent helps developers review findings and proposed fixes.
